must_contain: In M2 the HIP generates a linking token using the patient's ABHA address and demographic details, and the patient's care context is linked to the ABHA Address.
The first M2 call is POST /api/hiecm/v3/token/generate-token with the patient's ABHA number or ABHA address, name, gender and year of birth.

In P2 a PHR app discovers with /api/hiecm/user-initiated-linking/v3/patient/care-context/discover, carrying the hip and the unverifiedIdentifiers, and on successful verification of the OTP the care contexts link to the ABHA address.
notes: Group A, an imperative task phrase that spans two modules: it catches an answer that picks M2 or P2 alone, or hedges across both without naming either module or its first call. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/flows/m2-link-care-context.md, 'The HIP generates a linking token using the patient's ABHA address and demographic details for authentication' and step 1 'POST /api/hiecm/v3/token/generate-token'; catalogue/hiecm/flows/p2-discover-and-link.md, 'Discover with `/api/hiecm/user-initiated-linking/v3/patient/care-context/discover`, carrying the `hip` and the `unverifiedIdentifiers`' and 'on successful verification the care contexts link to the ABHA address'.
